models.name: current_legislators
models.description: Each record represents a current legislator.

columns.name: bioguide_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the legislator.

columns.name: full_name
columns.description: The official full name of the legislator

columns.name: num_served_terms
columns.description: The number of terms the current legislator has served, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_served_in_Maine
columns.description: Set to 1 if the current legislator has served in Maine, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: is_male_but_is_not_senator
columns.description: Set to 1 if the current legislator is male but is not a senator, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: is_Jewish_but_does_not_have_facebook
columns.description: Set to 1 if the current legislator is Jewish but does not have a Facebook account, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: has_a_nickname
columns.description: Set to 1 if the current legislator has a nickname, 0 otherwise.
